newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki starts sluggishly higher on cue from U.S..
newsitem.headline: Helsinki starts sluggishly higher on cue from U.S..

text.p: Shares opened cautiously higher on Monday on strong signals from the U.S. stock and bond markets, but early trade was sluggish, brokers said.
"We're waiting to see how Stockholm opens," one broker said, explaining the low-volume start.

"This is really playing wait-and-see," another broker said, adding: "The sellers are sticking up there, and buyers don't want to rise to those prices. The pessimists think this is just a passing thing, while the optimists see a rally."
Nokia added 3.00 markka to 331.00, struggling to match its higher Wall Street close in modest volume.
